svg.title: Engineering platform — pipeline
svg.desc: Engineering platform: Azure DevOps (source of truth) → historical inventory (Git DAG and REST, recovery by id) → security gate (secret scanning, fail-closed) → private fast-forward-only mirror preserving the SHAs of the authorized commits it mirrors → collector deduplicating by SHA → strict public JSON with aggregates only → profile SVG dashboard. Cross-cutting: least-privilege tokens per job, alerts that never close on inconclusive data, cost-aware scheduling and an independent read-only review.
